testimonials.name: Ramesh Kumar
testimonials.message: Amazing construction quality and timely delivery.

allGmbReviews.name: Umesh Ayare
allGmbReviews.quote:
I recently had the pleasure of working with SBS Construction and Interior, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, the experience was smooth, professional, and stress-free.

The quality of work was excellent, attention to detail was impressive, and everything was completed on time. He was very responsive, understood exactly what I wanted, and delivered beyond my expectations.

If you’re looking for reliable and skilled construction and interior work, I highly recommend SBS Construction and Interior. Definitely a well-deserved 5 stars!

allGmbReviews.name: Shivani Tannir
allGmbReviews.quote:
They did a good job at my place in Dombivili but spoilt the entire relationship and journey right at the end. Work was not completed as per scheduled timeline. I was shifting from another appartment and my house was a chaos with 2 truckloads of stuff right in the center of the house and the interior works still ongoing. We had sleepless nights with all the work going on as promise was not kept. They installed ACs for us in the middle of the night only to know that both my AC was leaking after installation. My bathroom washbasin has also been leaking for weeks now and they have not yet fixed it.
Ankit has stopped answering my calls or responding back to my messages to complete the pending work. I have to get my own thing done now.
Sincere suggestion, do not pay in full unless the full work is completed and you are satisfied. I dd the mistake. I feel they are very unprofessional.

allGmbReviews.name: Venkatraman Ramalingam
allGmbReviews.quote: They are good labourers with sincerity in their work . If there are any problems they are at your service. Hence you can very well rely on them

allGmbReviews.name: Ajay Mahto
allGmbReviews.quote: Absolutely thrilled with the construction work done at my home! From start to finish, the team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a commitment to excellence. The craftsmanship is impeccable, and the attention to detail is evident in every corner. Not only did they meet deadlines, but they also exceeded my expectations in terms of quality and service. Communication throughout the project was seamless, and any concerns were addressed promptly. I couldn't be happier with the results and would highly recommend their services to anyone looking for top-notch construction work."

allGmbReviews.name: Deepak Siyal
allGmbReviews.quote: I recently had a great experience with this civil contractor in Dombivli. The team was professional, skilled, and completed my project on time with excellent quality. Their pricing was transparent, and they kept me informed throughout the process. They turned my ideas into reality with perfect attention to detail. Highly recommend them for any construction work in Dombivli!
